description: This Java class represents the context for SASL responses in an AMQP adapter, encapsulating connection details, the SASL mechanism used, optional response fields for the PLAIN mechanism, and client certificates if available.

classes.name: SaslResponseContext
classes.description: A final class that stores information about the SASL handshake, including connection details, mechanism type, optional response fields for PLAIN mechanism, and client certificates.

methods.name: forMechanismPlain
methods.description: Factory method to create a SaslResponseContext instance for the PLAIN SASL mechanism, requiring the connection and response fields.

methods.name: forMechanismExternal
methods.description: Factory method to create a SaslResponseContext instance for the EXTERNAL SASL mechanism, requiring the connection and optional client certificate chain.

methods.name: getPeerCertificateChain
methods.description: Returns the client certificates if provided, null otherwise.

methods.name: getSaslResponseFields
methods.description: Returns the SASL response parts for the PLAIN mechanism, or null if not used.

methods.name: getRemoteMechanism
methods.description: Returns the SASL mechanism used by the remote connection.

methods.name: getProtonConnection
methods.description: Returns the connection object associated with this SASL response context.
